title: Finding Low-Competition Keywords for CPS Monetization in 2026
excerpt: Discover how to find low-competition keywords that drive high CPS commissions. Step-by-step guide using Ahrefs, keyword gap analysis, and buyer intent scoring for 2026.
content:
Cost Per Sale monetization lives and dies on keyword selection. Pick the wrong keywords and you burn ad spend with zero conversions. Pick the right low-competition keywords and you can earn $500 to $2,000 per month from a single piece of content. The secret is finding search terms where buyer intent is high but competition is low. This guide shows you exactly how to find them in 2026.

Most affiliate marketers target head terms with monthly volumes above 5,000. These keywords have keyword difficulty scores above 70 and require dozens of backlinks to rank. The smarter play is long-tail keywords with 100 to 1,000 monthly searches and difficulty scores below 30. According to Ahrefs data, pages ranking for low-difficulty keywords convert at 4.2% on average compared to 1.8% for high-difficulty terms.

## Use Ahrefs Keyword Gap Analysis

Start with Ahrefs Keyword Explorer and enter three competing sites in your niche. Run a keyword gap report to find terms your competitors rank for but you do not. Filter for keywords with a difficulty score under 30 and monthly search volume between 100 and 1,000. This instantly gives you a list of 50 to 200 untapped opportunities. The average solopreneur running this analysis once per month discovers 15 to 20 viable low-competition targets.

Cross-reference these keywords with CPS affiliate programs in your niche. Look for programs offering 20% to 50% commission rates with cookie durations of at least 30 days. Tools like PartnerStack and Impact Radius let you filter programs by commission structure. Prioritize keywords that align with products paying at least $50 per sale. At a 4% conversion rate, a keyword driving 500 monthly visitors generates $1,000 in commissions.

## Analyze Buyer Intent Signals

Not all low-competition keywords are worth pursuing. You need to separate informational queries from transactional ones. Use Ahrefs to check the top 10 ranking pages for each candidate keyword. If the results are dominated by product reviews, buying guides, or comparison pages, the intent is transactional. If they are mostly educational articles, move on. Transactional intent keywords convert at rates 3 to 5 times higher than informational ones.

Look for keywords containing modifiers like best, review, vs, alternative, cheap, discount, or top. These signal that the searcher is ready to buy. A keyword like best email marketing tool for freelancers with 300 monthly searches and a difficulty of 22 is far more valuable than email marketing tips with 4,000 searches and a difficulty of 65. The former may earn $1,200 per month in CPS commissions while the latter earns nothing.

## Build Topical Authority Clusters

Once you have identified 10 to 15 low-competition keywords, group them into topical clusters. Google rewards sites that demonstrate comprehensive coverage of a subject. If you are targeting CPS keywords in the web hosting space, create a hub page about web hosting for small businesses and link out to individual reviews of each hosting provider. This interlinking strategy boosts the ranking of every page in the cluster.

Publish one piece of content per week targeting your selected keywords. Each article should be at least 2,000 words with original screenshots, data tables, and personal experience. Pages with original data rank 3.2 times higher on average than those using only sourced information. Use Make to automate content publishing: when an article is ready in Google Docs, have it automatically formatted and scheduled in WordPress.

## Scale With ConvertKit Email Sequences

Capture the 96% of visitors who are not ready to buy immediately. Add an email opt-in to every article offering a related checklist or template. Use ConvertKit to create a five-email nurture sequence that provides value and builds trust before presenting your CPS offer. Sequences with three or more educational emails before the sales email have click-through rates of 12% compared to 4% for single-email blasts.

Track your conversion metrics religiously. The key numbers are page views, email opt-in rate, email click-through rate, and sale conversion rate. A healthy funnel sees 3% to 8% of page visitors opt in, 10% to 15% of email recipients click affiliate links, and 3% to 6% of clickers complete a purchase. If any metric falls below these ranges, refine your content or your email sequence until it improves.

## Realistic Revenue Expectations

With 20 articles targeting low-competition CPS keywords, each driving 300 monthly visitors, you can expect 500 to 1,000 sales per year depending on your niche and conversion rate. At an average commission of $50 per sale, that equals $25,000 to $50,000 in annual passive income. The top solo CPS operators in 2026 maintain 50 to 100 articles and earn $5,000 to $15,000 per month. Start with 20 articles, analyze what works, and double down relentlessly.
